# py_core pins: every package at an exact version AND at the sha256 of each distribution file pip may
# pick for it on CPython 3.13 / 3.14 (pyproject.toml: requires-python >= 3.13): the sdist, the
# pure-Python wheels and the cp313* / cp314* wheels of every platform. pip switches to --require-hashes
# mode by itself as soon as one requirement carries a hash, so a download that is not byte-identical to
# what was pinned fails the install instead of being run (audit F-B-007 / F-D-008, L-64).
#
# Bumping a pin means changing the version AND rebuilding that package's hash block from PyPI's JSON API
# (https://pypi.org/pypi/<name>/<version>/json -> urls[].digests.sha256) with the same file selection;
# a hash missing for the wheel a runner needs fails CI at the install step and nowhere else.
